firstMessage: I found the change point and its linked test. The repository’s `AGENTS.md` requires confirmation before changing `Sessions.Login` because it is linked to `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT`, which controls the account takeover risk. Please confirm that I may make the change; I’ll then update the test and add the required draft trace item.
finalMessage:
`Login` now returns `ErrLocked` on the failed attempt that locks the account. Earlier failed attempts still return `ErrBadCredentials`.

The change keeps `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT` true and adds draft item `R-LOGIN-LOCKED-NOTICE` for the immediate notice. Both link to `TestLoginLockout`; `go test ./accounts` passed. `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT` controls `RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER`, so that link should be reviewed in the pull request.
